votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session(A) for the purposes of the discussion of the character, professional competence, or physical or mental health of an individual and attorney-client matters.
votes.description: The Council voted to enter into a closed session to discuss matters related to an individual's character, professional competence, or physical or mental health, as well as attorney-client privileged matters.
The Council voted to conclude the first closed session and return to open session.
